ENVO UT21 Electric Golf Cart | Compact Utility and Passenger EV
The ENVO UT21 is a compact electric golf cart designed for passenger transportation, property mobility, recreation, and light utility work. Its small footprint, quiet electric drive, low operating cost, and adaptable layout make it ideal for golf courses, resorts, campuses, gated communities, parks, events, warehouses, farms, and large private properties. Unlike conventional golf carts built around one fixed layout, the UT21 can be tailored for carrying people, equipment, tools, luggage, supplies, or a combination of passengers and cargo.
Accessories shown may be optional, not included in the base price, or unavailable for individual sale. Check the product configuration or contact us for details.
